description: Angular component for managing mail server settings in the Thingsboard UI, including OAuth2 configuration, TLS, proxy, and email testing.

classes.name: MailServerComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring mail server settings, including OAuth2, TLS, proxy, and testing functionalities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, loads settings, templates, and configures form controls.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: initTemplates
methods.description: Initializes mail configuration templates.

methods.name: mailServerSettingsForm
methods.description: Sets up form controls and subscriptions for mail server settings.

methods.name: domainFormConfiguration
methods.description: Configures domain form behavior and URL parsing.

methods.name: enableOauth2
methods.description: Enables or disables OAuth2 related form controls.

methods.name: enableProviderTenantIdChanged
methods.description: Enables or disables provider tenant ID input based on provider type.

methods.name: enableProxyChanged
methods.description: Enables or disables proxy configuration inputs.

methods.name: enableMailPassword
methods.description: Enables or disables mail password input.

methods.name: enableTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS version selection.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Sends a test email using current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current mail server configuration.

methods.name: generateAccessToken
methods.description: Generates a new OAuth2 access token.

methods.name: redirectURI
methods.description: Constructs redirect URI based on domain form and schema.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: Parses a URL to extract protocol and host for redirect URI.

methods.name: accessTokenButtonName
methods.description: Returns the label for the access token button.

methods.name: accessTokenStatus
methods.description: Returns the status message for the OAuth2 token.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation.

methods.name: mailSettingsFormValue
methods.description: Extracts and cleans form values for saving.

methods.name: toggleEditMode
methods.description: Enables or disables a form control based on current state.
